scene: A scoop of mint gelato gives you sudden, sparking electric static.
picture: Flat side-view across the sunny piazza pavement. On the far left rests the hovering scooter. In the left-centre, the grandmother in her pink tracksuit holds a glowing green cone, sparks popping around her glasses beside her white dog. In the centre burbles the dolphin fountain, while a brass pasta spinner stands on the right.
shown: a bubbling marble dolphin fountain splashing water in the centre
a gleaming brass pasta spinner with winding copper handles on the right
a hovering turquoise scooter parked idling on the far left
